module: Profiling/diagnostic tool: using a debug.sethook hook on function calls, records who calls whom during a period, then exports the call graph in TGF format (openable in yEd). Loaded with require('utils/calltracer'). Debugging only.
usage:
local calltracer = require('utils/calltracer')
calltracer.reset()
calltracer.start()
-- code to examine
calltracer.stop()
calltracer.save('callgraph.tgf')
notes: C functions and unnamed functions (debug.getinfo().name nil) are ignored.
Each node is identified by name + source + definition line; an edge links the caller's caller (s2) to the immediate caller (s1).
The hook replaces any existing debug hook (debug.sethook / debug.sethook() with no argument to stop).
save() writes via the global writeFile; the node table is not cleared after saving, use reset().

start.desc: Installs the call hook (debug.sethook(trace, 'c')): calls are recorded from that moment.

stop.desc: Removes the hook (debug.sethook()). Nodes already recorded are kept.

save.desc: Writes the recorded call graph in TGF format (list of numbered nodes, '#' line, then the edges) to a file.

reset.desc: Clears all recorded nodes and edges.
